title: Slick
wikitext:
<!-- write a brief player introduction below and remove this line -->
Slick was a modemer and later lpb who played for Quake Police Department, one of the best clans in the UK and also for Darkside, winners of the UKCTFL (capture the flag league) in the UK.  Notorious for his Quad Camping, Slick was voted best CTFer in the UK in an online poll ran by popular columnist Methos.
